logic.namespace.note: The project publishes model code and weights as a repository. Nothing in it is a published unit of world logic named for other authors to depend on.

deliver.moderation.note: The generator returns its output to whoever ran it and describes no gate in between: the published module documentation covers the generation stages and their dependencies, with no safety classifier, prompt filter or review step in the pipeline and nothing recording what review an output has had. Source-available code makes any such gate the operator's to add.

geo.map-align.note: A generated interior is not a map of a real place and carries no transform to one.

geo.coverage.note: Nothing declares a region of the Earth over which a generated world applies.
